args.subject: Recommendation: Cascade Falls Trail for a Weekend Hike
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I wanted to recommend Cascade Falls Trail in the national park — it’s a great option for a weekend hike. It’s about 3 miles round trip and features beautiful waterfall views, so it’s scenic but still very manageable.

If you’d like, I can send directions or parking details, or we can pick a day to go together.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: Alex — Personal Trainer at Main Street Gym
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to recommend Alex, a wonderful personal trainer at the gym on Main Street. Alex is great at creating customized workout plans tailored to individual goals and fitness levels. They’re professional, supportive, and consistently help clients see real progress.

If you’re looking for one-on-one training or a personalized plan, I highly recommend giving Alex a try. Let me know if you’d like me to connect you or share Alex’s contact details.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: Sarah — Piano Teacher
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to recommend Sarah as a piano teacher. She’s a fantastic instructor who specializes in classical music and has over 15 years of teaching experience. She creates personalized lesson plans, works well with students of all ages and levels, and has a strong track record preparing students for performances and exams.

If you’d like, I can share her contact details or make an introduction.

Best regards,

args.subject: Recommendation: FitTrack — great for workouts & meal planning
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to recommend FitTrack — a new fitness app that's really helpful for tracking workouts and includes great meal-planning features. It's intuitive, lets you log exercises and progress, and the meal plans are customizable to different goals. I think you'd find it useful if you're tracking workouts or looking for structured meal guidance.

If you'd like, I can send the download link or a quick walkthrough of the app’s main features.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery downtown
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough bread is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6:00 AM and have a great selection of breads and pastries. If you enjoy fresh-baked goods, it’s definitely worth a visit.

Best regards,
